patch_description: Replaces random points with a deterministic multi-restart hill-climbing optimizer. Key insight: since the convex region is defined as the convex hull of the points themselves, every configuration is feasible — the objective is simply (smallest of 286 triangle areas)/(hull area). We start from symmetric seeds (rings plus boundary points) and run coordinate perturbation hill climbing with a shrinking step size, recomputing the minimum triangle area vectorized over all C(13,3)=286 triples (cheap: precomputed index array). Convex hull area is computed with a monotone chain hull. Fixed seed ensures determinism; the whole optimization completes in about a second, vastly improving min_area_normalized (from ~0.00 to above the benchmark, targeting combined_score > 1).
